title: Playback Transcode Policy Deepening
problem: Nako has Playback Sessions and FFmpeg-backed direct/remux/HLS paths, but playback planning, client capability negotiation, transcode reasons, hardware fallback, runtime inventory, and engine execution need deeper seams before Jellyfin-class playback/transcode features are added.

evidence.summary: Opened playback/transcode policy deepening lane and ADR 0038 after reviewing Jellyfin-class playback, device profile, transcode reason, encoding option, and transcode job lifecycle pressure.
Added direct-play characterization proving Playback Session is the durable user attempt and direct play creates no fake Transcode Session artifact; refreshed playback/transcode gates.

Extracted playback planning/profile/capability/reason records into nako-playback; reduced nako-streaming to direct byte-range transport mechanics; migrated server playback app and public DTO adapters to planner output.

continue_policy.notes: Continue with PTP-040 Client Playback Capabilities and Playback Decision Reasons before implementing Transcode Policy, Runtime Inventory, or FFmpeg Engine Adapter seams.
